description: Open a page in a real browser, run its JavaScript, and return the main content as clean Markdown with title, author, date and description, plus the links and images it holds. Navigation, ads, cookie banners and footers are left out. Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Web tools: A real browser for agents: screenshot any page on desktop or phone, read a page as clean Markdown, print a URL or HTML to PDF, draw HTML to an image, make social cards, audit a page for SEO, speed, accessibility and broken links, and compare two versions of a page pixel by pixel..

maxChars.description: Cut the inline Markdown at this length; the file always has all of it.

selector.description: Take only this element instead of detecting the main content.

url.description: Public http(s) address of the page.

waitFor.description: CSS selector that must be visible before the capture.

waitMs.description: Extra wait after the page has loaded, for animations or late content.
